description: Decision trail for AI agents. Each entry records a non-obvious decision, its rationale, and what an agent must NOT do. Source files reference these via '// @breadcrumb BC-NNN'. Validate with MachineCommentValidationTest.

entries.title: Process-wide engine, owner-scoped display
entries.decision: LvglEngine is a process-wide singleton; an activity binds/unbinds a display by owner identity instead of tearing the engine down.
entries.rationale: Tearing the engine down between activities showed the previous activity's screen and stalled the UI thread (ANR).
consequences: The native engine and its render thread outlive every activity.
A stale owner's deinitDisplay must be ignored.
do_not: Never call LvglEngine.shutdown() from an activity.
entries.ai_hint: When adding lifecycle code, reason about owner identity, not about activity destruction.

entries.title: Surface rebind fast path
entries.decision: On a same-size surface, keep the display and only rebind the ANativeWindow; do not tear the display down and rebuild it.
entries.rationale: Rebuilding the display on every activity transition both showed the wrong screen and wedged the UI thread (ANR).
consequences: A same-size initDisplay is a pure rebind.
A size change is the only case that rebuilds the display.
do_not: Do not join the render thread from the UI thread during a rebind.
entries.ai_hint: The fast path is the default; treat teardown as the exceptional branch.

entries.title: Never scheduleTask() under engine->mutex
entries.decision: Copy state under the lock, release it, and only then call scheduleTask().
entries.rationale: scheduleTask locks the same non-recursive mutex, so calling it while holding engine->mutex deadlocks the UI thread (ANR).
consequences: nativeSetScreen / nativeApplyTheme take the lock only to read flags.
A deadlock here presents as 'System UI isn't responding'.
do_not: Never call scheduleTask() while holding engine->mutex.
entries.ai_hint: Any new JNI entry point must follow the lock-copy-release-schedule pattern.

entries.title: Decorative LVGL objects must clear CLICKABLE/SCROLLABLE
entries.decision: Route every decorative object through decorative() so it cannot swallow taps from a clickable ancestor.
entries.rationale: A plain lv_obj is clickable by default; inner columns/labels captured presses so the card's LV_EVENT_CLICKED never fired.
consequences: Labels, accent bars and inner columns go through decorative().
Without it, taps silently do nothing.
do_not: Do not create a decorative container without clearing LV_OBJ_FLAG_CLICKABLE.
entries.ai_hint: If a tap handler never fires, suspect a decorative child stealing the hit test.

entries.title: Containers need explicit flex layout
entries.decision: Every container holding more than one child sets an explicit flex layout via make_row/make_column.
entries.rationale: A plain lv_obj has no layout, so all children are placed at (0,0) and overlap (card titles/subtitles stacked).
consequences: Multi-child containers must be created through the layout helpers.
Overlapping text is the symptom of a missing layout.
do_not: Do not add a second child to a container created with lv_obj_create().
entries.ai_hint: When two labels overlap, the parent has no layout set.

entries.title: LVGL fonts are fixed pixel sizes
entries.decision: Pick fonts through ui_font(dp, dpi) and spacing through dpx(dp, dpi); never use lv_font_montserrat_NN directly.
entries.rationale: LVGL fonts are fixed pixel sizes, so lv_font_montserrat_14 renders ~5sp text on a 440dpi display.
consequences: Montserrat ships only up to size 48; that is the ladder cap.
The enabled sizes must match lv_conf.h.
do_not: Do not reference lv_font_montserrat_56/64/72; they do not compile.
entries.ai_hint: Text that is unreadably small means a font was chosen in pixels instead of dp.

entries.title: BGRA to RGBA swap in the flush callback
entries.decision: Swap R/B channels per pixel in display_flush_cb before copying to the ANativeWindow.
entries.rationale: LVGL stores lv_color32_t as {blue,green,red,alpha}; Android RGBA_8888 expects {red,green,blue,alpha}.
consequences: Colors are inverted without the swap.
nativeCaptureFrame returns 0xRRGGBB ints, not raw memory.
do_not: Do not change the window format without re-checking the channel order.
entries.ai_hint: Red and blue swapping means the byte order assumption changed somewhere.

entries.title: Status text cached per screen id
entries.decision: Cache the last status text together with the screen id it belongs to, and re-apply it in rebuild_screen().
entries.rationale: onResume re-asserting the screen triggers a rebuild that reset the label to its initial text, so live status was wiped.
consequences: lastStatusScreen scopes the cache so text cannot leak between screens.
An onResume rebuild restores live status instead of losing it.
do_not: Do not apply cached status to a different screen id.
entries.ai_hint: If status resets after resume, the rebuild is not re-applying the cached text.

entries.title: Navigation bridge requires JNI_OnLoad
entries.decision: Store the JavaVM in JNI_OnLoad and cache method IDs in nativeSetNavCallback; drain requests on the LVGL thread.
entries.rationale: Removing JNI_OnLoad left g_vm null, so nav_valid() was always false and navigation silently failed.
consequences: Navigation only works if JNI_OnLoad is present.
Requests are drained by the LVGL thread, never the UI thread.
do_not: Do not call Kotlin from native on a thread that is not attached to the JVM.
entries.ai_hint: Silent navigation failure means g_vm or the cached method IDs are missing.

entries.title: LvglActivity subclasses must not setContentView()
entries.decision: Activities extending LvglActivity must not call setContentView(); switch content via LvglEngine.setScreen().
entries.rationale: setContentView replaces the LVGL SurfaceView and produces the greyed-out 'System UI isn't responding' screen.
consequences: The base class owns the root layout and SurfaceView.
Use AppCompatActivity when native Android views are needed.
do_not: Do not call setContentView() from a LvglActivity subclass.
entries.ai_hint: A greyed-out UI after a screen switch is almost always a setContentView regression.

entries.title: Re-assert screen id on resume
entries.decision: LvglActivity records its screen id and re-asserts it in onResume when the display shows a different screen, skipping the first resume.
entries.rationale: The display is process-wide, so returning to an activity that never re-requested its screen showed the wrong screen.
consequences: firstResume skips the redundant initial request.
Only a differing screen id triggers a rebuild, avoiding flicker.
do_not: Do not rebuild the screen on every resume unconditionally.
entries.ai_hint: Wrong screen after back navigation means onResume is not re-asserting the id.

entries.title: DIRECT render mode, full-screen framebuffer
entries.decision: Use LV_DISPLAY_RENDER_MODE_DIRECT with two full-screen framebuffers.
entries.rationale: Partial rendering had ANativeWindow swapchain issues.
consequences: The flush callback always copies the full display.
Two buffers avoid tearing between LVGL and the window.
do_not: Do not switch to partial rendering without fixing the swapchain path.
entries.ai_hint: A black screen usually means buffers were set after the flush callback.

entries.title: LV_THEME_DEFAULT_LIGHT is undefined in LVGL 9.6.0
entries.decision: Define LV_THEME_DEFAULT_LIGHT as 0 when the header does not provide it.
entries.rationale: LVGL 9.6.0 does not define the light theme constant, so referencing it fails to compile.
consequences: Light mode uses 0; dark mode uses LV_THEME_DEFAULT_DARK.
The fallback must stay guarded by #ifndef.
do_not: Do not reference LV_THEME_DEFAULT_LIGHT without the #ifndef guard.
entries.ai_hint: A missing light-theme symbol means the guard was removed or LVGL changed.

entries.title: Guard tests must fail loudly and prove they detect violations
entries.decision: Guard tests locate the repo root by walking up, assert the path exists, and include canary fixtures that must be detected (and clean fixtures that must not be).
entries.rationale: A hardcoded relative path once resolved outside the repo, so exists() was false and two of three rules silently no-opped (false green).
consequences: A broken path fails the suite instead of passing it.
Each detector is proven to catch a real violation and to ignore a clean fixture.
do_not: Do not weaken a detector until its canary test is updated too.
entries.ai_hint: If a guard goes green after a regression, its canary is missing or broken.

entries.title: Machine-readable comment schema and breadcrumb trail
entries.decision: Source files carry structured @tag annotations that cross-reference this trail; MachineCommentValidationTest parses and validates every annotation in the repo.
entries.rationale: AI agents need a machine-readable trail of non-obvious decisions instead of prose scattered across markdown.
consequences: Every annotation must use a known tag and a resolvable reference.
Orphaned breadcrumbs and dangling references fail the build.
do_not: Do not add an annotation with an unknown tag or a dangling BC-/ADR- reference.
entries.ai_hint: New non-obvious decisions should get a BC entry plus an in-code @breadcrumb.

entries.title: Demo UI is a single source of truth
entries.decision: All demo/sample screens are declared in demo_ui.h and implemented in demo_ui.cpp; the port only owns the engine and JNI.
entries.rationale: Splitting UI code across the port and demo files duplicated screens and made the widget set drift.
consequences: Screens are added by declaring a builder in demo_ui.h.
The port calls launch_screen() and nothing else UI-specific.
do_not: Do not build screens directly in lvgl_port.cpp.
entries.ai_hint: A screen change belongs in demo_ui.cpp, not the engine.

entries.title: Public ui_* UI-kit API
entries.decision: demo_ui.h declares the public UI-kit API (ui_make_panel, ui_make_column, ui_make_label, ui_decorative, ui_dpx, ui_dpi) and demo_ui.cpp defines it; demo_showcase.cpp consumes it.
entries.rationale: The showcase demo is a separate translation unit, so the helpers it uses must have external linkage and match the header exactly.
consequences: The ui_* helpers are non-static in demo_ui.cpp.
Renaming a helper requires updating demo_ui.h, demo_ui.cpp and every consumer.
A mismatch surfaces as an ld.lld undefined-symbol error, not a compile error.
do_not: Do not declare a ui_* helper in demo_ui.h without defining it in demo_ui.cpp.
entries.ai_hint: If the link fails on a ui_* symbol, the header and demo_ui.cpp have drifted.

entries.title: Frame callback lifetime
entries.decision: Engine::reset() must not clear the frame callback; the showcase sets it while the screen is built and clears it via ui_reset_showcase() when the screen is left.
entries.rationale: The render thread starts after the screen is built and calls Engine::reset(); clearing the callback there left the showcase without its per-frame driver, so windows never animated.
consequences: Engine::reset() clears springs/points/colors but keeps frame_callback_.
ui_reset_showcase() clears the callback and resets g_show before lv_obj_clean().
launch_screen() calls ui_reset_showcase() whenever the target is not the showcase.
do_not: Do not clear frame_callback_ in Engine::reset().
entries.ai_hint: If a window never animates, check whether the frame callback survived Engine::reset().

entries.title: Window overlay must ignore the parent layout
entries.decision: The window's backdrop and container carry LV_OBJ_FLAG_FLOATING so they ignore the parent's flex layout.
entries.rationale: A 2000x2000 backdrop in a flex column consumed the column and pushed the tiles off-screen; LVGL also ignores lv_obj_set_pos() for children of a laid-out parent.
consequences: Both bg_close_ and container_ are FLOATING.
The container's animated x/y via lv_obj_set_pos() is honoured.
do_not: Do not add a large overlay as a plain child of a flex parent.
entries.ai_hint: If an overlay makes siblings vanish, it is participating in the parent's layout.
